# General FAQ

## Articles

[How Safety Cloud® Works to Keep Roadway Responders Safe](https://support.haasalert.com/help/how-does-safety-cloud-work)

Safety Cloud® enables real-time digital alerts from emergency and roadway vehicles to nearby drivers. Learn how the system works and see a video overview.

[Will Safety Cloud® show vehicle location without active emergency lights?](https://support.haasalert.com/help/does-safety-cloud-show-the-location-of-vehicles-when-emergency-lights-arent-activated)

Learn when Safety Cloud® alerts are broadcast from vehicles. This article explains why alerts only appear when emergency lights are active, how to verify alerts, and how this supports driver safety and privacy.

[Can Safety Cloud® be installed on older emergency vehicles?](https://support.haasalert.com/help/safety-cloud-does-safety-cloud-work-on-older-emergency-vehicles)

Learn how Safety Cloud® works with older emergency vehicles, new electric rigs, and even non-vehicle assets like arrow boards and lane gates. Explore hardware and hardware-free integration options.

[Which vehicles and navigation apps are supported by HAAS Alert®?](https://support.haasalert.com/help/when-will-haas-alert-partner-with-my-favorite-navigation-application-or-vehicle)

Learn which vehicle brands and navigation apps HAAS Alert currently partners with, including Jeep, Chrysler, Waze, and more. Stay informed on future digital alerting partnerships.

[How long does it take to install Safety Cloud®?](https://support.haasalert.com/help/does-safety-cloud-require-a-complicated-installation)

Learn how quick and easy it is to install Safety Cloud® on your vehicle or fleet. Installation can take as little as 15 minutes, and integration with existing systems is even faster.

[What does ‘HAAS’ stand for, and how did the company name originate?](https://support.haasalert.com/help/what-does-haas-stand-for)

Learn how the HAAS Alert name originated—from an early acronym to honoring founder Cory Hohs after a near-miss incident that inspired the company’s mission.

[How to update your custom Waze message for emergency alerts](https://support.haasalert.com/help/how-can-i-update-my-waze-message)

Learn how to request a custom Waze hazard message through HAAS Alert and what limitations apply to message content and formatting.

[What is Responder-to-Responder (R2R) and how does it work?](https://support.haasalert.com/help/how-does-responder-to-responder-r2r-work)

This article explains how HAAS Alert’s Responder-to-Responder (R2R®) system works to help prevent emergency vehicle collisions.

[Is Safety Cloud® available internationally?](https://support.haasalert.com/help/is-safety-cloud-available-outside-the-united-states-canada)

Safety Cloud® is available internationally. This article explains global availability and how to check for support in your region.

[How do I let my community know we've implemented Safety Cloud®?](https://support.haasalert.com/help/community-awareness)

Get templates, images, and messaging from HAAS Alert to help announce your Safety Cloud® implementation to the public and local media.

[How do I refer a department or fleet to HAAS Alert?](https://support.haasalert.com/help/refer-a-fleet)

Learn how your agency can participate in HAAS Alert’s Referral Program and earn up to $12,500 in credits by referring a department or fleet.

[Are HAAS Alert devices FCC, CE, and RCM certified?](https://support.haasalert.com/help/are-haas-alert-devices-fcc-ce-and-rcm-certified)

HAAS Alert hardware is FCC, CE, and RCM certified to meet safety and regulatory standards in the U.S., EU, and Australia/New Zealand.

[How does HAAS Alert handle data privacy and security?](https://support.haasalert.com/help/how-does-haas-alert-handle-data-privacy-and-security)

This article explains how HAAS Alert protects user data and ensures security through encryption, access controls, and SOC 2 compliance. Learn more at our Trust Center.
